name: Juan Álvaro Díaz Raimond Kedilhac
bio: Juan Álvaro’s research interests span both macroeconomic and microeconomic empirical analysis, with a particular focus on econometric methods and machine learning applications in economics. His work combines causal inference, time-series analysis, and high-dimensional statistical techniques to study inflation dynamics and household behavior. He is especially interested in applying modern quantitative methods to policy-relevant questions in macroeconomics, health, and labor markets. He has led workshops on GitHub and LaTeX, supporting research collaboration, reproducibility, and scientific communication.
